title: TwinICL: Diagnosing Multimodal In-Context Learning through Paired Counterfactuals
abstract: arXiv:2609.15028v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables models to infer tasks from demonstrations, but existing benchmarks generally lack matched text and image versions needed to compare ICL performance across modalities. We introduce TwinICL, a procedurally generated benchmark providing such pairs for controlled comparison. Across six open-weight models and 38 tasks, multimodal ICL consistently underperforms text-only ICL, with gaps varying by task family. To test whether this gap can be recovered, we target visual access, task framing, and reasoning through three interventions. Their combination recovers strong multimodal ICL performance on a diagnostic subset, despite limited or inconsistent individual effects. To distinguish difficulties in executing tasks from those in inferring them, we evaluate models with explicit task instructions, revealing a modality gap even when the task is known. translated_title: TwinICL：通过成对反事实诊断多模态上下文学习
translated_abstract: 上下文学习使模型能够从示范中推断任务，但现有的基准测试通常缺乏匹配的文本和图像版本，无法用于比较跨模态的ICL性能。我们提出了TwinICL，一个程序化生成的基准，提供此类配对以进行受控比较。在六个开放权重模型和38个任务的评估中，多模态ICL的表现始终不及纯文本ICL，且差距因任务族而异。为检验这一差距能否被弥补，我们通过三种干预措施分别针对视觉访问、任务框架和推理进行测试。尽管各干预措施单独效果有限或不一致，但它们的组合在诊断子集上恢复了较强的多模态ICL性能。为区分执行任务与推断任务的困难，我们使用明确的任务指令对模型进行评估，结果显示即使任务已知，模态差距依然存在。随后，我们考察了添加示范输入和输出的影响……
tldr: 提出了程序化生成的TwinICL基准，利用匹配的文本-图像反事实配对系统诊断多模态上下文学习，发现多模态ICL始终弱于纯文本ICL，且即使任务已知模态差距依然存在。
en_tdlr: TwinICL, a procedurally generated benchmark with paired text-image counterfactuals, systematically reveals that multimodal in-context learning consistently underperforms text-only ICL, and a modality gap persists even when the task is explicitly known.
